_readme: Copy to config/agent.json (gitignored) and edit. Every field is optional — delete what you don't need.
No secrets here: all keys live in config/api_keys.json (see api_keys.example.json). See docs/INTEGRATIONS.md.
_confirmation_mode: strict = confirm every change · balanced = confirm external/destructive (default) · trusted = confirm destructive + flagged pushes only
_workspaces: Folders the agent may work in freely. Empty/missing → Desktop, ~/Projects, ~/source/repos … that exist.
_claude_code: mode 'copy' = prompt + Copy button (always works). mode 'local' = also run it with the `claude` CLI when it is on PATH.
_decision_provider: Optional fast model for routing/next-action JSON, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. {"base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1", "model": "qwen2.5:7b"} — its key, if any, goes in api_keys.json as decision_api_key
